## Overview

A tooltip is a small bubble that explains the thing it points at. It is built for web, iOS and Android from one design and one token set. Typical MakeMyTrip uses: what a fare component means on the fare breakup, what "Free cancellation" covers on a hotel card, or a one-time hint that points at a new filter.

There are two types:

- **Plain** is one short label, up to about two lines, with nothing to tap inside. It explains a control or an icon and goes away by itself.
- **Rich** holds an optional bold title, body text, an optional action link and an optional close button. Because it holds things to tap, it stays open until it is dismissed.

Each type comes in two surfaces:

- **Dark** is a near-black bubble with white text and no border or shadow. It is the default, and it matches the Slider tooltip and the inverse Snackbar.
- **Light** is a white bubble with a hairline border and the overlay shadow. Use it over photos, maps and dark sections, beside a strong brand button where a near-black bubble would compete with it, or where a long Rich message reads better on white.

The bubble can sit on any side of its trigger, with the caret at the start, centre or end of that edge, or with no caret at all.

### When to use something else

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| A message about something the user just did, such as "Added to trip" | [Snackbar](snackbar.md) |
| A list of actions to choose from | [Menu](menu.md) |
| Content longer than a title and about three lines, or a form | A bottom sheet or dialog (not in Cosmos yet) |
| Information the user needs to complete the task, such as a fare rule that changes the price | Show it inline on the page. Never hide required information in a tooltip |
| A label for an icon-only button on touch | Give the button a visible label or an accessible name. A Plain tooltip on long-press is a supplement on Android, not a replacement |

### Composition

- **Tooltip** is the bubble with its caret. Three variant axes: Type, Surface and Placement.
- **Tooltip / Close** is the close button inside a Rich tooltip, with its own Surface and State axes. It is nested in every Rich variant and shown through the `Close` property.
- The **Slider** nests an instance of Tooltip (Plain, Dark, Top Center, or None when its caret is off) above its thumb. The instance rebinds its bubble, text, padding, radius and caret to the Slider's own `slider/tooltip-*` variables, at the same values, and uses `label/small/bold` (12 / 16) for the number; see [Slider](slider.md).

## Platforms

| | Web | iOS | Android |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain opens | Hover on the trigger after 300 ms, or keyboard focus. On touch screens a tap on the trigger, as on mobile | Tap on the trigger, such as an info icon | Tap on an info trigger, or long-press on an icon button (the Material convention) |
| Plain closes | Pointer leaves both the trigger and the bubble, blur, or Esc. Stays open while the pointer is over the bubble (WCAG 1.4.13) | After 4 s, a tap anywhere, or a scroll | After 4 s, a tap anywhere, or a scroll |
| Rich opens | Click or tap on the trigger, or Enter or Space when it is focused | Tap on the trigger, or automatically once for an onboarding hint | Tap on the trigger, or automatically once for an onboarding hint |
| Rich closes | Close button, the action, a click outside, or Esc. Focus returns to the trigger | Close button, the action, or a tap outside | Close button, the action, a tap outside, or system Back |
| Edge spacing | At least `viewport-margin` (8) from the viewport edge | At least `screen-margin` (16) from the safe area edge | At least `screen-margin` (16) from the safe area edge |
| Hit area | The trigger and the Rich close button are at least 24 × 24 (WCAG 2.5.8); use `min-touch-target` (48) on touch screens | At least 44 × 44 pt; `min-touch-target` (48) covers it | At least `min-touch-target` (48) dp |
| Hover and focus states | Yes | Focus only with a hardware keyboard | Focus only with a hardware keyboard |
| Base | A positioned layer, for example with Floating UI or the Popover API with CSS anchor positioning | A custom overlay anchored to the trigger. `.popover` with `presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover)` (iOS 16.4+) for Rich if a native arrow is acceptable | Material 3 `TooltipBox` with `PlainTooltip` and `RichTooltip` (`isPersistent = true`), with Cosmos tokens replacing the Material colours, shapes and padding |

Only one tooltip is open at a time; opening another closes the first. A tooltip never opens on page load except a Rich onboarding hint, which shows once per user and is remembered after it is dismissed.

## API

> `Placement` is the preferred position. In code the tooltip flips to the opposite side when there is no room, and shifts along the edge to stay inside the margins, with the caret still aimed at the centre of the trigger.

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | plain \| rich | `plain` | Rich is persistent and may hold interactive content; Plain may not. |
| `surface` | enum | dark \| light | `dark` | Light over imagery and dark sections. |
| `placement` | enum | top \| bottom \| left \| right, each with -start \| -center \| -end | `top-center` | Start and End are the left and right ends of a Top or Bottom tooltip in left-to-right layouts, and the top and bottom ends of a Left or Right tooltip. They mirror in right-to-left layouts. |
| `showCaret` | boolean | true \| false | `true` | Without the caret the bubble stays in the same place. |
| `label` | string | (string) | – | Plain text, or the Rich message. |
| `title` | string | (string) | – | Rich only. Optional. |
| `actionLabel` | string | (string) | – | Rich only. Optional. Short, such as "Got it" or "Learn more". |
| `onAction` | callback | `() => void` | – | Rich only. Runs the action and closes the tooltip. |
| `showClose` | boolean | true \| false | `true` | Rich only. Hide it only when the action itself dismisses, such as "Got it". |
| `open`, `onOpenChange` | boolean, callback | – | – | Controlled open state, for onboarding hints. |
| `delay` | number | ms | `300` | Web hover delay for Plain. Focus opens without a delay. |
| `duration` | number | ms | `4000` | Auto-dismiss time for Plain on touch. Rich never auto-dismisses. |

### Figma-only properties

| Figma property | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Type` | VARIANT | Plain | Plain or Rich. |
| `Surface` | VARIANT | Dark | Dark or Light. |
| `Placement` | VARIANT | Top Start | Top, Bottom, Left and Right, each Start, Center or End, plus None for no caret. The name says where the bubble sits relative to the trigger, so Top has the caret on its bottom edge pointing down. Figma defaults to the first variant; the code default is `top-center`. |
| `Label` | TEXT | `"Label"` | Plain text. |
| `Title` | TEXT | `"Title"` | Rich only. |
| `Message` | TEXT | `"Message"` | Rich only. |
| `Action` | TEXT | `"Action"` | Rich only. |
| `Show title` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Rich only. |
| `Show action` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Rich only. |
| `Close` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Rich only. Shows the nested Tooltip / Close. |

Tooltip / Close has `Surface` (Dark, Light) and `State` (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus). State is design-only: in code it comes from `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible` on web and from the press state on mobile.

Every variant ships placeholder copy only. Realistic copy lives in the `Tooltip examples` frame.

## Behaviour

- **One at a time.** Opening a tooltip closes any other open tooltip.
- **Hoverable (web).** Moving the pointer from the trigger onto a Plain bubble keeps it open, so text can be read and selected. A 100 ms grace period covers the gap between them.
- **Never essential.** Anything the user must know to finish the task is shown on the page. A tooltip adds context; it does not hold the only copy of it.
- **Placement and collision.** The tooltip prefers its `placement`. When it would cross the margin it first flips to the opposite side, then shifts along the edge. The caret keeps pointing at the centre of the trigger, and never gets closer than `caret-inset` to a corner. If the trigger itself is off screen, the tooltip closes.
- **Scroll.** On mobile a scroll closes a Plain tooltip. A Rich tooltip follows its trigger while it scrolls, and closes once the trigger leaves the screen.
- **Text.** Plain wraps at `max-width` (240). Copy that needs more than two lines belongs in Rich or a bottom sheet. Rich wraps at `rich-max-width` (320). Text never truncates.
- **Font scaling.** With Dynamic Type or Android font scaling the width stays capped at max-width and the bubble grows taller. At the largest accessibility sizes on a small phone a Rich tooltip can fill the width minus `screen-margin` on both sides.
- **Right-to-left.** Start and End mirror, and so does the position of the close button.
- **Trigger.** On touch the trigger is usually an info icon or a text link with a dotted underline. Give it at least `min-touch-target` of hit area, even when the icon is 16 or 20.

### Motion (not tokenised yet)

- **Enter:** fade from 0 to 1 and slide 4 px from the trigger towards the final position, over 150 ms ease-out.
- **Exit:** fade out over 100 ms ease-in, without moving.
- **Reduce Motion:** fade only, with no slide.
- On Android, `TooltipBox` animates by default; replace its animation with the values above.

## Structure

### Anatomy

```text
Tooltip (component set · 854:516 · Type x Surface x Placement = 52 variants)
├─ Caret row (fills the edge facing the trigger · inset caret-inset · Start, Center or End) · not in Placement None
│  └─ Caret (8 × 5 frame, 5 × 8 on Left and Right, overlapping the bubble by 1)
│     ├─ Fill (triangle in the bubble colour)
│     └─ Edge (Light only · open stroke on the two outer edges in border-light, border-width thick)
└─ Bubble (auto layout)
   ├─ Plain: Label (text · body/small/regular, 12 / 18 · fills the width and wraps) · padding 8 × 12 · radius 8 · hugs up to max width 240
   └─ Rich: horizontal, gap 0 · padding 12 top and bottom, 16 left, 8 right · radius 12 · 320 wide
      ├─ Content (vertical, gap 8, 8 right padding) · fills the width
      │  ├─ Text (vertical, gap 2)
      │  │  ├─ Title (text · title/small/bold, 14 / 22) · Show title
      │  │  └─ Message (text · body/small/regular, 12 / 18)
      │  └─ Action (text · label/medium/bold, 14 / 20) · Show action
      └─ Close (instance of Tooltip / Close, top-aligned) · Close

Tooltip / Close (component set · 853:29 · Surface x State = 8 variants)
├─ Button (24 × 24, radius 4, fill only on Hover and Pressed)
│  └─ Close icon (16)
└─ Focus ring (2 thick, 2 outside the button) · Focus only
```

The caret row comes before the bubble for Bottom and Right, and after it for Top and Left. Bottom and Right variants reverse the stacking order so the caret is drawn over the bubble and hides the bubble border where they meet.

The Rich right side adds up from two parts: the bubble's own right padding (`padding-end-close`, 8) and the Content's right padding (`rich-gap-close`, 8). With Close, that is text, 8, close button, 8, edge. Without Close, the text sits 16 from the edge, the same as the left side.

### Dimensions

| Property | Plain | Rich | Token |
|---|---|---|---|
| Padding (top and bottom × sides) | 8 × 12 | 12 × 16 | `tooltip/padding-y`, `padding-x`, `rich-padding-y`, `rich-padding-x` |
| Right padding with Close | – | 8 | `tooltip/padding-end-close` |
| Corner radius | 8 | 12 | `tooltip/radius`, `rich-radius` |
| Maximum width | 240 | 320 | `tooltip/max-width`, `rich-max-width`. Figma draws Rich at a fixed 320 because its wrapping text cannot hug; in code it hugs up to 320 |
| Height, one line | 34 | depends on content | 18 line plus padding |
| Gap: title to message | – | 2 | `tooltip/rich-gap-text` |
| Gap: message to action | – | 8 | `tooltip/rich-gap-action` |
| Gap: text to close button | – | 8 | `tooltip/rich-gap-close` |
| Close button and icon | – | 24, icon 16, radius 4 | `tooltip/close-size`, `close-icon-size`, `close-radius` |
| Caret | 8 × 4 visible | 8 × 4 visible | `tooltip/caret-width` (height is half). Figma draws it 5 tall and overlaps the bubble by 1 so no seam shows |
| Caret inset from the corner, Start and End | 12 | 12 | `tooltip/caret-inset` |
| Gap: trigger to caret tip | 4 | 4 | `tooltip/offset` |
| Gap: trigger to bubble, no caret | 8 | 8 | `tooltip/offset` plus the caret height |
| Border, Light only | 1 | 1 | `tooltip/border-width` |
| Focus ring | 2 thick, 2 outside | same | `tooltip/focus-ring-width`, `focus-ring-offset` |
| Hit area: trigger, close and action | 48 | 48 | `tooltip/min-touch-target` |
| Edge margin | 16 mobile, 8 web | same | `tooltip/screen-margin`, `viewport-margin` |

## Color

Token names follow `tooltip/{part}-{surface}`, with `-hover` and `-pressed` on the close button fills.

| Element | Dark | Light |
|---|---|---|
| Bubble and caret | `bg-dark` → `bg-surface-inverse` #0A0A0A | `bg-light` → `bg-surface-secondary` #FFFFFF |
| Border | none | `border-light` → `border-secondary` #E5E5E5 |
| Shadow | none | `shadow-light` → `shadow.overlay` |
| Plain label and Rich title | `label-dark` → `text-inverse` #FFFFFF | `label-light` → `text-primary` #0A0A0A |
| Rich message | `description-dark` → `text-inverse-secondary` #A1A1A1 | `description-light` → `text-secondary` #525252 |
| Action link | `link-dark` → `text-link-inverse` #83D4FF | `link-light` → `text-link` #0067E8 |
| Close icon | `icon-dark` → `icon-inverse-secondary` #A1A1A1 | `icon-light` → `icon-secondary` #525252 |
| Close fill, Hover | `close-bg-dark-hover` → `bg-fill-inverse-hover` #171717 | `close-bg-light-hover` → `bg-surface-secondary-hover` #FAFAFA |
| Close fill, Pressed | `close-bg-dark-pressed` → `bg-fill-inverse-pressed` #262626 | `close-bg-light-pressed` → `bg-surface-secondary-pressed` #F5F5F5 |
| Focus ring | `focus-ring` → `border-focus` #0681FF | `focus-ring` → `border-focus` #0681FF |

The Rich message uses the description colour with or without a title, so turning the title off never changes the message colour. It passes 4.5:1 on both surfaces (7.66 and 7.81).

This component adds no semantic roles.

### Semantics

| | Web | iOS / VoiceOver | Android / TalkBack |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain | The bubble has `role="tooltip"` and an `id`; the trigger points at it with `aria-describedby`. It is never focusable. Esc closes it without moving focus | The tooltip text is the trigger `.accessibilityHint`, so VoiceOver reads "Fare info, button. Convenience fee is charged per traveller." The bubble itself is hidden from VoiceOver. Double-tap shows it visually | `TooltipBox` sets the tooltip as the trigger description, so TalkBack reads it after the trigger label. The bubble is not focusable |
| Rich | The trigger has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. The bubble is a non-modal dialog (`role="dialog"`, `aria-labelledby` the title, or `aria-label` without one). Focus moves to the bubble on open and returns to the trigger on close. Tab order: action, then close | Post `.screenChanged` with the bubble as the new focus, so VoiceOver reads the title and message. The close button is "Close, button" and comes last. A two-finger scrub (escape) closes it | The bubble is a pane (`paneTitle` = the title) and takes TalkBack focus on open. Back closes it and returns focus to the trigger |
| Trigger | A real `<button>` with an accessible name, such as "Fare info". Not a bare icon | `.accessibilityLabel`, plus `.isButton` | `contentDescription`, plus `Role.Button` |
| Auto-dismiss | Never on web | Plain hides after 4 s visually, but the hint stays on the trigger, so nothing is lost | Same as iOS |

A Plain tooltip never holds a link or a button, because a pointer or screen reader user cannot reach it before it closes. Anything interactive makes it Rich.

## Platform mapping

| | Web | iOS (SwiftUI) | Android (Compose) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fill | `background: var(--tooltip-bg-dark)` | `.background(CosmosTokens.tooltipBgDark)` | `containerColor = CosmosTokens.tooltipBgDark` |
| Padding | `padding: var(--tooltip-padding-y) var(--tooltip-padding-x)` | `.padding(.vertical, CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingY).padding(.horizontal, CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingX)` | `Modifier.padding(horizontal = CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingX, vertical = CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingY)` |
| Shape | `border-radius: var(--tooltip-radius)` | `RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: CosmosTokens.tooltipRadius)` | `shape = RoundedCornerShape(CosmosTokens.tooltipRadius)` |
| Light shadow | `box-shadow: var(--tooltip-shadow-light)` | Two `.shadow` modifiers from `tooltipShadowLight1*` and `tooltipShadowLight2*` | Two layers from `tooltipShadowLight1*` and `tooltipShadowLight2*` |
| Caret | A rotated square or a CSS `clip-path` triangle, `var(--tooltip-caret-width)` wide | A `Path` triangle in the same fill, with the Light border stroked on its outer edges | `caretSize = DpSize(CosmosTokens.tooltipCaretWidth, CosmosTokens.tooltipCaretWidth / 2)` on `PlainTooltip` and `RichTooltip` |

```css
.tooltip[data-surface="dark"] {
  background: var(--tooltip-bg-dark);
  color: var(--tooltip-label-dark);
  padding: var(--tooltip-padding-y) var(--tooltip-padding-x);
  border-radius: var(--tooltip-radius);
  max-width: var(--tooltip-max-width);
}
.tooltip[data-surface="light"] {
  background: var(--tooltip-bg-light);
  color: var(--tooltip-label-light);
  border: var(--tooltip-border-width) solid var(--tooltip-border-light);
  box-shadow: var(--tooltip-shadow-light);
}
```

## Known gaps

- **No arrow-key or hover state on touch.** Hover exists only on web. The Tooltip / Close Hover variant is web-only.
- **Caret border on Light.** Figma draws the caret as a separate vector over the bubble border; in code, draw the bubble and caret as one path so the border is continuous.
- **Literal values in Figma.** Everything else is bound to a variable. Three geometry values are not: the -1 gap that overlaps the caret onto the bubble, the 5 px drawn depth of the caret, and the Close focus ring (radius 8, 32 × 32, which is the button plus `focus-ring-offset` and `focus-ring-width` on each side).
- **No motion tokens.** Durations and easing are documented above, not tokenised.
- **No dark mode.** All variable collections are single-mode. In a future dark theme the Light surface would be the one to adapt.
- **Not uSpec-generated.** This file is hand-authored next to the Figma build.

## Token reference

41 tokens under `component.tooltip` in `tokens/tokens.json`. 40 are mirrored 1:1 as `tooltip/*` in the Figma `component` collection. The Figma file has no shadow variables, so `shadow-light` is the `shadow/overlay` effect style on the Light bubble there.

| Group | Count |
|---|---|
| Surface: `bg-dark`, `bg-light`, `border-light`, `border-width`, `shadow-light` | 5 |
| Text: `label-dark`, `label-light`, `description-dark`, `description-light`, `link-dark`, `link-light` | 6 |
| Close button: `icon-dark`, `icon-light`, `close-bg-dark-hover`, `close-bg-dark-pressed`, `close-bg-light-hover`, `close-bg-light-pressed`, `close-size`, `close-icon-size`, `close-radius` | 9 |
| Focus and touch: `focus-ring`, `focus-ring-width`, `focus-ring-offset`, `min-touch-target` | 4 |
| Plain layout: `padding-x`, `padding-y`, `radius`, `max-width` | 4 |
| Rich layout: `rich-padding-x`, `rich-padding-y`, `padding-end-close`, `rich-radius`, `rich-max-width`, `rich-gap-text`, `rich-gap-action`, `rich-gap-close` | 8 |
| Caret and position: `caret-width`, `caret-inset`, `offset`, `screen-margin`, `viewport-margin` | 5 |

Platform names follow the standard pipeline: `tooltip/bg-dark` → `--tooltip-bg-dark` (CSS) → `CosmosTokens.tooltipBgDark` (Swift / Kotlin) → `tokens.tooltip["bg-dark"]` (TS).
